name: Special Meeting of the Beautification and Maintenance Commission
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  BEAUTIFICATION AND MAINTENANCE COMMISSION

  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVE
  ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA - (562) 865-6262

  THURSDAY, AUGUST 22, 2019

  6:00 P.M.

  COMMISSIONER MIGUEL NAVARRO
  COMMISSIONER KATHY HARRISON
  COMMISSIONER CRISALYN TORRE
  COMMISSIONER JENNIFER VARENCHIK

CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ELECTION OF NEW CHAIRPERSON AND VICE CHAIRPERSON

COMMUNICATION FROM THE AUDIENCE
This is the time for public input relative to issues on or not on the printed agenda.
Please observe the time of three (3) minutes. Speaker Cards are available at the door
and may be delivered to the recording secretary prior to the commencement of the
meeting.
OLD BUSINESS
  1. Approval of the Beautification and Maintenance Commission Meeting
  Minutes: June 4, 2019 - Special Meeting, June 11, 2019 – Special Meeting,
  and June 25, 2019 – Special Meeting, July 25, 2019 – Regular Meeting.

  2. Potential City Monument Signs

  3. Utility Boxes Artwork Program

  4. Hosting a Beautification and Maintenance Commission Event at the City’s
  New Community Support Center

  Page 1 of 2
 NEW BUSINESS
  5. Conducting a Beautification and Maintenance Commission Outreach Table
  at the 2019 International Street Fair and Diversity Festival

  6. Graffiti Removal on Private Property

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS

ADJOURNMENT TO THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING OF THE BEAUTIFICATION
AND MAINTENANCE COMMISSION TO BE HELD ON THURSDAY, OCTOBER 17,
2019, AT 6:00 P.M. IN THE ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER AT 18750
CLARKDALE AVE., ARTESIA.

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please
contact City Hall at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
